derivation: from an unused root meaning to alienate;
def: a mongrel, i.e. born of aJewish father and aheathen mother

occurrences.text: A bastard shall not enter into the congregation of the Lord; even to his tenth generation shall he not enter into the congregation of the Lord.
And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
